description: Static consistency registry for Claude Code leaf role agents. The Lead Agent (professor) is the only spawner. graduate-student, code-reviewer, scientific-validator, cache-log-auditor, and workflow-manager are spawned leaf agents (graduate students and code reviewers may run in parallel). Runtime tool isolation is provided by Claude Code agent frontmatter; this file keeps leaf role definitions, skill declarations, and orchestration templates from drifting.

contracts.runtime_enforcement: Claude Code loads .claude/agents/graduate-student.md and applies its tools frontmatter; check_spawn_contracts.py enforces static consistency only. The graduate student writes and runs code and offers interpretation as hypotheses, but does not pronounce the binding pass/fail verdict (that is the scientific-validator) or promote claims.

Claude Code loads .claude/agents/code-reviewer.md and applies its tools frontmatter; check_spawn_contracts.py enforces static consistency only. The code reviewer reads code statically (no execution); behavioural validation is the scientific-validator's job.
Claude Code loads .claude/agents/scientific-validator.md and applies its tools frontmatter; check_spawn_contracts.py enforces static consistency only.
Claude Code loads .claude/agents/cache-log-auditor.md and applies its tools frontmatter; check_spawn_contracts.py enforces static consistency only.

Claude Code loads .claude/agents/workflow-manager.md and applies its tools frontmatter; check_spawn_contracts.py enforces static consistency only. The workflow manager refreshes and reports workflow state; it does not run experiments, modify research code, or interpret results.
Claude Code loads .claude/agents/peer-review-professor.md and applies its tools frontmatter; check_spawn_contracts.py enforces static consistency only.
